**Download one:** `Kami-oke-Setup-2.2.0.exe` installs with shortcuts; `Kami-oke-2.2.0-Portable.exe` runs without installing. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway** (the app isn't code-signed). Your songs, singers and settings carry over.

### 2.2.0
- **Change the key of YouTube videos** (desktop app). Use the Key buttons or `[` `]` on a YouTube song: Kami-oke switches it to YouTube's own page and shifts its audio live, keeping the tempo. The music runs about a tenth of a second behind the picture while the key is changed; back at the original key there's no delay. Remembered per song.
- **Singers are remembered.** Names you type are saved and shown as one-click picks under the Singer box. **Edit singers** lets you rename or delete them; renaming also updates anyone already in Up next.

See the [2.1.0 notes](https://github.com/terpenesalad/karaoke/releases/tag/v2.1.0) for the rename to Kami-oke and playing YouTube videos that block embedding.
